label: Cobwebby Corridor
literalRoomDescription: A winding corridor is filled with cobwebs. Some are broken and the dust on the floor is disturbed. The trend of the twists and turns is northeast to southwest. On the north side of one twist, high up, is a narrow crack.
safeSceneProfile: Twisting NE/SW corridor, broken cobwebs and disturbed dust; high northern crack remains a source-backed narrow opening, not a full-height doorway.
